payload.subject: Phase 1 module spec + one design fork: how phases line up across frames
payload.rationale: You told me to build Phase 1 fully parallel, no shared boundary, so I'm treating the Crystal Bravais wavetable as my own standalone artifact — not an export layer for the Torus work. Here's the plan in four pieces. First, a frame generator: for each of the seven Bravais crystal systems, synthesize one full cycle of that lattice's combined phonon partial spectrum. Second, frame interpolation: blend smoothly between those seven cycles into a 64- or 256-frame table you can sweep with one knob. Third, a writer that packs those frames into a valid Serum-format WAV. Fourth, a plain-WAV fallback for Ableton. One fork shapes the frame generator and I want to settle it before any code: how the cycles line up when you sweep. Reset each frame to a known starting point (clean sweeps, but it can flatten transient character), or carry the phase through (richer motion, risk of hollow comb-filter artifacts). I'm holding the Serum writer until a known-good reference WAV is confirmed on the Mac.

options.label: Reset every frame to the same starting point — predictable, clean sweeps; safest default
options.next: Frame generator emits each cycle phase-aligned to a fixed reference before interpolation.

options.label: Carry phase continuously across frames — richer motion, but risks comb-filter artifacts on the sweep
options.next: Frame generator preserves running phase; add an artifact listen-test before committing.

options.label: Reset now, expose carry-through as an option once the pipeline works end to end
options.next: Ship Phase 1 on zero-phase reset; defer continuous-phase to a later toggle.

payload.subject: Cycle 9 — Phase 3 first source landed. Full Crystal keyboard + Interview skill out of draft.
payload.content:
Catching everyone up. Generative Sample Libraries is the chat-driven multisampled-instrument generator. Phase 1 (Talking Keyboard) and Phase 2 (the Interview skill) shipped. Phase 3 is multi-source — prove the same pipeline works against something other than Kokoro TTS. Cycle 8 built an 8-file Hexagonal Crystal audition unit via a thin adapter over Crystal Audio/crystal_synth.py; you approved it on gsl-steward-012 with APPROVE.

This cycle does what your APPROVE green-lit:

1. **Full chromatic Crystal instrument shipped.** All 88 notes (A0..C8) x 2 velocity layers = 176 WAVs, 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit, ~60 MB total. Single SFZ at [crystal_instrument.sfz](open:Projects/Generative Sample Libraries/crystal-instrument/crystal_instrument.sfz) covering the whole range as per-key zones across two velocity groups. Every voicing setting (FUNDAMENTAL_GAIN=0.30, 3 ms ampeg_attack, decay_exp/transient_decay per layer) carried forward unchanged from the unit you approved. The full-batch script lives next to the audition script as [generate_full.py](obsidian://open?vault=The%20Palace&file=Projects/Generative%20Sample%20Libraries/crystal-instrument/generate_full.py); cycle 8's generate.py is preserved as the audition record.

2. **Interview skill promoted out of draft.** The frontmatter at [_ops/sample-libraries/skills/interview/SKILL.md](obsidian://open?vault=The%20Palace&file=_ops/sample-libraries/skills/interview/SKILL.md) is now status: active — Phase 3 has a non-Kokoro source proven end-to-end, which was the graduation criterion. I left the file at its project-local home; moving it into your user-skill space at /skills/sample-library-interview/ is a separate deposit ceremony (I shouldn't be writing into your skill directory autonomously).

Honest wrinkles I want surfaced: (a) pitch verification across 176 files shows mean |error| 2.0 cents, median 0.5 cents, 86% under 5 cents — but the worst case is 12.7 cents on F1 (43.65 Hz target). That's almost certainly FFT bin quantization in the verification step rather than a real pitch error (at 30-50 Hz with a 1.5 s analysis window, bin resolution is ~0.67 Hz ≈ 25 cents at the low end — the measured values match this quantization). The rendered audio uses the same exact base_freq computation as the audition; nothing in the synthesis is octave-dependent. Worth a spot-check by ear on the bottom octave when you next open this in sforzando. (b) Cycle 8's generate.py had BUILD_DIR pointed at _ops/sample-libraries/crystal-instrument/ but the actual artifacts shipped to Projects/Generative Sample Libraries/crystal-instrument/ (project-bundle convention). The new generate_full.py points at the correct project-bundle path. I noted this in the build log.

What remains in Phase 3: source two and three (a local WAV folder; an AI audio sub-agent). The adapter pattern proven here generalizes — any palace synthesis module that takes a base frequency can drop into the same shape. Closing well: my next-cycle baton is to either (a) pick the next Phase 3 source and re-enter through the Interview, or (b) consolidate this milestone back into the home entry (the footer still says cycle 8 + 1 blocking audition open; both are now stale). I have not edited the home page this cycle — deposit-back is reserved for milestone consolidation and I want to propose that move rather than just do it.
